root_cause.text: A copy-paste error in __audit_log_capset() caused it to store the effective capability set into the inheritable field of CAPSET audit records instead of the actual inheritable capability set.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "records the effective capability set into the inheritable field due to a copy-paste error," and the patch diff shows the fix changing `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_effective;` to `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_inheritable;`.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: A copy-paste error in __audit_log_capset() caused it to store the effective capability set into the inheritable field of CAPSET audit records instead of the actual inheritable capability set.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message explicitly states "records the effective capability set into the inheritable field due to a copy-paste error," and the patch diff shows the fix changing `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_effective;` to `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_inheritable;`.

candidates.rationale: Sets the PID for the audit record; part of the same function but not directly related to the vulnerability.
Correctly assigns the effective capability set; this line was likely the source of the copy-paste that led to the error in the inheritable assignment.
Vulnerable statement: due to a copy-paste error, it assigns the effective capability set to the inheritable field instead of the actual inheritable set from new->cap_inheritable.
Correctly assigns the permitted capability set; not directly related but part of the same assignment block.
Correctly assigns the ambient capability set; not directly related but part of the same assignment block.
Sets the audit record type; not directly related to the vulnerability but part of the function.

vuln_statements.explanation: Vulnerable statement: due to a copy-paste error, it assigns the effective capability set to the inheritable field instead of the actual inheritable set from new->cap_inheritable. This causes incorrect audit records for the inheritable capability set.
This correct assignment of the effective capability set is the likely source of the copy-paste error that led to the vulnerability in the inheritable assignment.
Sets the PID for the audit record; part of the same function __audit_log_capset() but not directly related to the capability set copy-paste error. Included as context.

Correctly assigns the permitted capability set; not directly related to the vulnerability but part of the same assignment block and demonstrates the pattern that was incorrectly followed for inheritable.

Correctly assigns the ambient capability set; not directly related to the vulnerability but part of the same assignment block and provides context showing that only the inheritable assignment was erroneous.
Sets the audit record type to AUDIT_CAPSET; not directly related to the vulnerability but part of the function after the capability assignments.
